description: Find structurally or evolutionarily related proteins. by:"sequence" runs an RCSB mmseqs2 sequence-similarity search (synchronous; experimental PDB entries only — protein_search_structures with a sequence also reaches computed models) over a sequence — supplied directly, taken from one protein entity of a PDB entry (chain picks it; by default the lowest-numbered protein entity of at least 10 residues; queryEntityId names it), or pulled from a UniProt accession (isoforms included) or entry name (HBA_HUMAN); each hit carries its identity, E-value, bit score, and aligned range. by:"structure" runs a Foldseek fold-similarity search (asynchronous) against experimental and predicted databases, uploading the PDB entry's mmCIF file or the accession's AlphaFold DB model, up to 16,000,000 characters; if the job is still computing when the poll budget elapses, or the call's 50 s budget runs out after Foldseek accepted the job, the response reports status "computing" with a ticket — re-call with ticket_id set to that value to resume the same job instead of resubmitting, and a complete response carries the same ticket so a finished job can be re-paged with a different start. Foldseek searches each chain of a multichain structure as its own query: a response covers one query (query, default 0), reports queryCount, and ranks that query's hits by score across all searched databases. Each mode reads only its own controls: sequence, chain, max_evalue and min_identity belong to by:"sequence"; ticket_id, databases and query belong to by:"structure"; pdb_id, uniprot, start and limit are shared. A field the selected mode cannot consume is rejected rather than silently ignored. A UniProt accession merged into another entry answers for its successor with a notice; a demerged or deleted one fails with its replacements. Output names the engine and database each hit came from; a structure hit also carries its Foldseek target name, and an id only where that name maps to a PDB entry or UniProt accession that protein_get_structure resolves.

chain.description: Author chain ID (auth_asym_id, case-sensitive) of pdb_id selecting the protein entity whose sequence by:"sequence" searches, e.g. "B" for the beta chain of 4HHB. Requires pdb_id. Default: the lowest-numbered protein entity of at least 10 residues; DNA and RNA chains never qualify.

databases.description: Foldseek target databases (by:structure), by exact name. Default pdb100 + afdb50. pdb100: experimental PDB entries; afdb50, afdb-swissprot, afdb-proteome: AlphaFold DB models; cath50: CATH domains of PDB chains and AlphaFold models; bfvd_v3: predicted viral proteins; mgnify_esm30, gmgcl_id: predicted metagenomic proteins; bfmd: predicted complexes.

pdb_id.description: PDB entry ID to derive the query from. by:"sequence" searches one of its protein entities (see chain); by:"structure" uploads its mmCIF file, up to 16,000,000 characters.

query.description: Zero-based Foldseek query index (by:structure). Default 0. Foldseek splits a multichain structure into one query per chain, in file order; queryCount in the response says how many the job holds. Pass the same value with ticket_id to resume or re-page that query.

sequence.description: Protein sequence for by:sequence: at least 10 residues in A–I or K–Z (J excluded; B/O/U/X/Z accepted). Whitespace is removed and ASCII lowercase normalized.

start.description: Zero-based result offset. Pages a by:sequence search, and a completed by:structure job when re-called with its ticket_id.

ticket_id.description: Foldseek ticket ID from a prior by:structure response whose status was "computing". When set, polls that existing job instead of submitting a new search (by:structure only) — pdb_id/uniprot/databases are ignored.

uniprot.description: UniProt identifier to derive the query from: a canonical accession (e.g. P69905), an isoform accession (e.g. P04637-2), or a UniProtKB entry name (e.g. HBA_HUMAN), which resolves to its entry’s accession. by:"sequence" searches its UniProt sequence, by:"structure" its AlphaFold DB model. A merged accession answers for its successor, with a notice.

name: protein_find_similar

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `chain_not_found`: chain names no protein polymer entity of the pdb_id entry: no such author chain, a DNA or RNA chain, or a case mismatch. `chain_without_pdb_id`: chain was supplied under by:"sequence" without pdb_id. `databases_rejected`: Foldseek refused the structure job submission with HTTP 400: it no longer accepts a requested database name. `inactive_accession`: UniProt lists the uniprot accession as inactive: demerged into several entries, or deleted. `invalid_accession`: uniprot is shaped like none of a canonical accession (P69905), an isoform accession (P04637-2), or a UniProtKB entry name (HBA_HUMAN). `invalid_sequence`: A raw or identifier-resolved RCSB protein sequence contains invalid residues or has fewer than 10 residues after whitespace removal, a pdb_id protein entity picked by chain or by default included. `missing_query`: None of sequence, pdb_id, or uniprot was provided. `mode_mismatched_field`: An input field only the other by mode consumes was supplied: sequence, chain, max_evalue or min_identity under by:"structure"; ticket_id, query or a non-empty databases list under by:"sequence". `no_sequence`: No query could be derived from the identifier: by:"sequence" found no such PDB entry, no protein polymer entity in it, or no UniProt sequence for the accession or entry name; by:"structure" found no UniProt entry for the entry name, or no AlphaFold DB model with a PDB-format file for the accession. `query_out_of_range`: The requested query index is not below the number of queries the completed Foldseek job holds. `search_failed`: The Foldseek search service rejected or failed the structure job. `structure_too_large`: The query structure's coordinate file is longer than 16,000,000 characters, the most this tool uploads to Foldseek. `ticket_not_found`: The supplied ticket_id was rejected by Foldseek as an invalid or expired ticket. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hits.description: Similar proteins, best first. Structure hits are ranked by score across all searched databases (hits without a score last, ties by database then target).

items.description: A similar protein, with alignment scores when available.

alignmentLength.description: Alignment length in columns, gaps included.

bitscore.description: Alignment bit score from mmseqs2 (sequence hits); a structure hit carries its bit score as score.

chain.description: Matched chain of the PDB entry in id (structure hits). pdb100: the author chain ID (auth_asym_id) in the assembly file Foldseek indexed, with a -N suffix marking a symmetry copy (A-2) — drop the suffix before passing it as chain to protein_get_annotations. cath50: the chain of the domain, absent when CATH recorded none.

database.description: Source database the hit came from (structure hits).

entityId.description: Matched polymer-entity ID (e.g. 1A00_1) for sequence hits; the chainable entry ID is in `id`.

id.description: Hit identifier that chains directly into protein_get_structure: a bare PDB entry ID (e.g. 1A00), or a UniProt accession for a predicted model. Absent on a structure hit whose target names neither (bfvd_v3, mgnify_esm30, gmgcl_id, bfmd) — read target and database instead.

identity.description: Sequence identity 0–1 over the alignment, to 4 decimal places.

organisms.description: Source organisms. Sequence hits: those of the matched polymer entity (entityId), not the whole entry, absent when the entry metadata names none for it. Structure hits: the organism of the target from the Foldseek taxonomy, one element — absent for mgnify_esm30 and gmgcl_id, which carry no taxonomy, and for unclassified targets.

probability.description: Estimated probability (0–1), from Foldseek, that the query and hit are homologous (structure hits).

queryEnd.description: Last aligned residue of the query, 1-based, inclusive.

queryStart.description: First aligned residue of the query, 1-based, inclusive.

score.description: Ranking score. by:"sequence": the RCSB relevance rank within the result set, bit scores rescaled from 1 (best hit) to 0 (worst) — a rank, not a similarity measure; read identity, evalue, and bitscore for that. by:"structure": the Foldseek alignment bit score.

source.description: Whether the hit is an experimental or predicted structure. Structure hits are experimental for pdb100 entries and cath50 domains of PDB chains, and predicted for every other database, cath50 domains of AlphaFold models included.

target.description: Foldseek target name (structure hits): the header text before the first space, as Foldseek returns it — e.g. 1crn-assembly1.cif.gz_A (pdb100), AF-P01542-F1-model_v6 (AlphaFold DB), 1cbnA00 (a cath50 domain), MGYP001043648370.pdb.gz (mgnify_esm30). Read it with database; the only handle on a hit with no id.

targetEnd.description: Last aligned residue of the hit, 1-based, inclusive, in the same indexed sequence as targetStart.

targetLength.description: Length in residues of the hit sequence that targetStart and targetEnd index into.

targetStart.description: First aligned residue of the hit, 1-based, inclusive, in the sequence the search indexed for that hit — not author residue numbering. For a sequence hit that sequence is the matched polymer entity (entityId); for a structure hit, the indexed chain, model, or CATH domain.

taxId.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the organism in organisms (structure hits; present exactly when a structure hit carries organisms).

title.description: Title: the entry title (sequence hits and pdb100 structure hits), or the name of the modeled protein (AlphaFold DB and bfvd_v3 structure hits).

uniprotAccession.description: UniProt accession of the modeled protein (structure hits from AlphaFold DB, bfvd_v3, and cath50 domains of AlphaFold models). A bfvd_v3 hit carries it without an id; pass it to protein_get_annotations.

nextStart.description: Offset for the next result page; absent on the final or past-end page.

notice.description: Advisory note: a structure job still computing, or one the call’s time budget cut off after submitting (with how to resume it), no matches, a start past the end of the results, other queries in a multichain structure job, the default protein entity a pdb_id sequence query searched alongside the entry’s other protein entities, or a merged UniProt accession answered for its successor.

query.description: Zero-based Foldseek query index the hits belong to (by:structure).

queryCount.description: Number of queries the Foldseek job holds, one per chain of the submitted structure (by:structure, complete). Valid query values run from 0 to queryCount - 1.

queryEntityId.description: Polymer entity of pdb_id whose sequence by:"sequence" searched (e.g. 4HHB_1). Present only when the query came from pdb_id.

queryLength.description: Length in residues of the query sequence that queryStart and queryEnd index into on every hit (complete responses whose hits carry aligned ranges; for by:structure, the chain of the selected query).

start.description: Zero-based offset of the returned result page.

status.description: complete with hits, or computing (async — re-call with ticket_id to resume).

ticketId.description: Async job ticket ID (by:structure). Present while status is computing, and also on a complete response — re-call with ticket_id plus a different start/limit to page the same finished job instead of resubmitting.

title: protein-mcp-server: find similar
